input_cap_derivation.formula: wire C*10 + epsilon0*3.9/tox*W*L*1280; round up to2pF/10pF as sensitivity assumption; not extracted fullbank characterization
input_cap_derivation.exclusions: full common rails, voltage-dependent gate charge/overlap, actual switching coupling, distributed effective load and complete PDN

limitations: Same proxy will apply at all integration corners; not independent TT/SS/FF data.
No WL->OUT arcs; PC phase proxy cannot establish decoder or WL timing closure.
No power numbers; missing macro power must remain separately unmeasured.
No minperiod/minpulse constraints because macro has no clock; physical phase protocol must be checked externally.
Output slew1ns is an explicit assumption; load/slew dependence uncharacterized.
